What compliance work looks like today

  • Checklists by hand Documents checked line by line against rules in a binder.
  • Requests in an inbox Privacy and data requests tracked in email, with deadlines at risk.
  • Proof assembled later Audit evidence rebuilt from memory when someone asks.
  • Policies nobody can find Staff ask the same procedure questions again and again.

What we build

Built in accounts you own. The agent drafts, checks, or flags; a person makes the call.

  1. Checks against your rules Documents and labels checked against your requirements, with issues flagged for a reviewer. The agent never signs off.
  2. Requests tracked to completion Privacy and data requests logged, routed and followed until they're closed.
  3. An audit trail by default Every check records what was read, what was found, and who approved it.

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us the job that eats your week and the tools it touches. We will say plainly whether it is worth building.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connections in accounts you own, starting with the tools that task needs.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent drafts, checks, or flags. Someone on your team approves anything that matters.
  4. 04 Hand over You get the code, the documentation, and the access. Keep us on for support, or don't.
